meta.name: spotify-api
meta.description: Create and manage Spotify playlists, search music, and control playback using the Spotify Web API. UNIQUE FEATURE - Generate custom cover art images (Claude cannot generate images natively, but this skill can create SVG-based cover art for playlists). CRITICAL - When generating cover art, ALWAYS read references/COVER_ART_LLM_GUIDE.md FIRST for complete execution instructions. Use this to directly create playlists by artist/theme/lyrics, add tracks, search for music, and manage the user's Spotify account.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Spotify 歌单并生成封面图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果:你常用 Spotify,想把歌单创建和封面自动化。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Spotify playlist creation and cover art generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Spotify and want to automate playlist creation and cover design.

howto.what: Claude 能连接你的 Spotify 账号,按歌手、主题、歌词或歌单列表创建歌单,搜索音乐、增删曲目、控制播放,还能为歌单生成 SVG 风格自定义封面图(生成前必读说明文件)。
howto.when: 用户要求创建歌单、搜索音乐或管理 Spotify 账号时,包括生成封面图这类操作。

say.text: 把The Beatles的热门歌曲做成歌单
say.note: 按歌手搜索并自动创建歌单添加曲目。

say.text: 给这个歌单生成一张封面图
say.note: 读取指南后生成SVG封面并尝试上传。

say.text: 帮我搜索一些安静的独立音乐
say.note: 按关键词搜索返回匹配曲目。

howto.what_en: Connects to Spotify to create playlists, search music, manage tracks, control playback, and generate SVG-based cover art (after reading the required guide).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a playlist, search music, or manage their Spotify account, including generating cover art.

say_en.text: Create a playlist with The Beatles' top songs.
say_en.note: Searches the artist and builds the playlist automatically.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this playlist.
say_en.note: Reads the guide, makes an SVG cover, and uploads it.

say_en.text: Search for some chill indie music.
say_en.note: Returns matching tracks from the query.
